flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/cart then Verify the cart shows "Cart is empty" and the header cart badge shows 0.
Go to http://localhost:3000/ and click the "Add shirt to cart" button exactly 3 times in total. Do not add clicks based on the cart badge or any other page state.
Open the cart page. Verify the Settled Tee row shows a quantity of exactly 3 and the cart total is exactly $54.00.
Click Checkout. Verify the checkout summary lists 3 × Settled Tee and the order total is exactly $54.00.
Click "Place order". Verify the order confirmation shows a charged amount of exactly $54.00.
